exceptions.reason: Next 16.2.12 bundles PostCSS 8.4.31, which requires nanoid 3.x. No compatible nanoid 3.x release fixes the zero-size custom-generator advisory. The application does not import nanoid or accept an application-controlled generator size. Review when Next/OpenNext publish a stable compatible dependency update.

The vulnerable PostCSS copy is privately bundled by Next 16.2.12. The application has no runtime PostCSS API path and only processes repository-controlled CSS during build. Do not force-replace Next's private PostCSS; review when a stable supported Next/OpenNext line carries the patched dependency.
